definitions: A fermented milk drink similar to yogurt, originating from the North Caucasus, made with kefir grains.
A symbiotic culture of bacteria and yeasts (SCOBY) used to ferment milk or water, forming grains.
examples: She enjoys a glass of kefir every morning.
The recipe calls for plain kefir.
You can make your own kefir at home with starter grains.
